resources.string: Uploads only locally detected, completed INR transaction alerts to your private budget endpoint.

I consent to this app reading every inbox SMS from the current India-time month on each sync. Filtering happens on the phone. Only messages with an explicit INR amount, completed payment/debit/refund/transfer evidence, and a non-personal automated sender are uploaded. Phone-number/unknown senders, OTP/authentication, promotions, balances, statements/due notices, requests/pending/failed events, self-transfers, card-bill confirmations, order-status-only messages, and ordinary personal messages are excluded. Uploaded fields are a redacted automated sender, timestamp, and minimized/redacted transaction body. The private server checks the same rules again. If optional Gemini merchant categorization runs, it receives only a locally hashed row ID and sanitized merchant/payee name; it does not receive the SMS body, sender, amount, timestamp, account, or reference. A count-only completion checkpoint proves the full monthly scan finished. Permission can be revoked in Android Settings.
Shared HMAC secret (leave blank to keep saved secret)
